title: Distill writes a worker.run line per closed headless worker session
goal: OPS_EVENTS gets worker.run (item, ms); ql_distill writes one line per closed session that has a branch row of an item and no agent rows, ms being the session's last row time minus its first; a session without a branch row, such as an orchestrator's, gets none; the weekly digest counts them; querylog.md and usage.md say so.

run: import os,sys,json,subprocess as sp,tempfile,shutil;from pathlib import Path;t=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp());d=t/'d'/'querylog';d.mkdir(parents=True);(d/'config.json').write_text(json.dumps({'mode':'local'}));os.environ['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA']=str(t/'d');os.environ['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT']=str(Path.cwd());sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import ql_capture as q;r=lambda s,sf,m,**k:q.record(sf,s,ts='2026-10-07T10:%s:00.000Z'%m,prompt_id=s+'p',**k);r('w1','prompt','00',prompt='go');r('w1','work','01',action='branch',item='ST-aaaaaaaa');r('w1','stop','07');r('o1','prompt','00',prompt='go');r('o1','work','02',action='claim',item='ST-bbbbbbbb');r('o1','stop','09');[(d/'spool'/(s+'.end')).write_text('') for s in ('w1','o1')];p=sp.run([sys.executable,'_tools/querylog.py','distill'],capture_output=True,text=True);w=[json.loads(l) for f in (d/'store'/'ops').glob('*/*.jsonl') for l in f.read_text().splitlines() if 'worker.run' in l];shutil.rmtree(t);g=[(x.get('item'),x.get('ms')) for x in w];print('distill',p.returncode,p.stdout.strip()[-60:],'worker.run lines',g);sys.exit(0 if g==[('ST-aaaaaaaa',420000)] else 1)

notes: Premise (2026-10-07): committed agent.run rows are 74 general-purpose, 45 kb-worker, 8 other, 1 explore, none a headless worker; the check's distill writes no worker.run line. Its orchestrator session (a claim row only) proves a session outside the rule gets none. Whether the item must have a file in the distilling clone, as kept_rows needs for windows, is open: the planted item has none.
